description: 基于脱敏实习场景构造的媒体资源运营黄金测试集，标准答案由人工确认的DuckDB SQL生成。
business_definition: media_resources代表当前歌曲资源；仍未配置专属封面 = image_path为public_third_part.jpeg。故事资源属于独立的stories表，不混入本表。

cases.question: 帮我找出目前还没有配置专属封面的歌曲
cases.gold_sql: SELECT resource_id AS 资源ID, cn_file_name AS 歌曲名称, artist AS 歌手, album AS 专辑, category AS 分类, image_path AS 当前封面 FROM media_resources WHERE image_path = 'public_third_part.jpeg' ORDER BY resource_id

cases.question: 统计目前各分类仍在使用默认封面的歌曲数量
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category AS 分类, COUNT(resource_id) AS 歌曲数量 FROM media_resources WHERE image_path = 'public_third_part.jpeg' GROUP BY category ORDER BY 歌曲数量 DESC, 分类

cases.question: 找出已经配置专属封面的歌曲
cases.gold_sql: SELECT resource_id AS 资源ID, cn_file_name AS 歌曲名称, image_path AS 当前封面 FROM media_resources WHERE image_path <> 'public_third_part.jpeg' ORDER BY resource_id
